observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show stacks of used tires inside a roadside shed/shop, shot from a distance.
Tires are piled many-deep; no single tire is isolated or shown as 'the item for sale'.
Sidewalls show faded paint marks (chalk/paint dashes) typical of used-tire sorting, but no brand name is legible on any sidewall.
In photo 1 and 2 a partial size code 'P22...' is visible on one tire but the rest of the digits are cut off/unreadable.
No DOT date code, no tread-depth gauge or coin, no close-up of any single tire's full sidewall or tread face is shown.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / IKWE ANTHONY' overlays all three images; this is a stock/catalog shot of the seller's shop, not of a specific unit.

identity.kind: used (tokunbo) car tire, size and brand not legible

claims.evidence: No brand name, country-of-origin marking, or distributor certificate is visible in any photo; this is a seller self-description.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge
claims.evidence: Photos are distant group shots; no close-up of tread depth, no coin/gauge reference, no isolated sidewall to check for patches or bulges.
No DOT date code, invoice, or removal photo/video shown; cannot confirm vehicle age or removal date from a stack of tires.

risks.risk: Tire size/diameter/load rating unknown, which is the main price driver
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the full sidewall showing size code (e.g., 205/55R16) and load/speed index for the specific tire being sold
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case without this

risks.risk: Actual tread depth could be much lower than claimed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread groove with a coin or tread-depth gauge inserted
Photo of DOT date code on sidewall (last 4 digits = week/year)
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock, not confirmed fresh

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall bulges, cracks, or repairs obscured by stacking
risks.proof: Individual photo/video of each candidate tire rolled out showing full sidewall and inner face

risks.risk: Which exact tire(s) in the pile the buyer would receive is unclear (shop inventory shot, not a single listed item)
risks.proof: Seller points to/photographs the specific unit(s) reserved for this buyer
risks.if_unproven: cannot assign a single item's worst case without this

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the sidewall of the exact tire(s) for sale showing full size code and brand name
Photo of the DOT date code on the same tire(s)
Close-up of tread with a coin or gauge for depth verification
Photo/video of the tire rolled out to show the entire sidewall and inner liner for bulges/patches
response.reason: The photos show a general shop stock of unidentified-size, unbranded used tires with no close-up of any specific unit, so even a worst-case price cannot be set until a clear sidewall photo reveals the size/brand of the actual tire(s) offered.
